backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining the backend for a Vedic consultation booking app, with types for services, categories, and bookings, plus public functions to create bookings and an admin-only function to retrieve all bookings using an access control mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (exact business address display, JSON-LD structured data update, WhatsApp deep-link audit) to their affected files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document containing one-to-two sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, hooks, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes using OKLCH color values, applied to base elements like body and borders.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with comprehensive SEO meta tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, and a JSON-LD LocalBusiness structured data block including the exact postal address and a Plus Code Google Maps URL.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with two routes: '/' rendering HomePage and '/admin' rendering AdminPage.
frontend/src/components/admin/BookingsTa: Admin bookings display component rendering a responsive desktop table and mobile card layout with formatted service type, category, status badges, and booking details styled with the cosmic/gold theme.
frontend/src/components/booking/BookingF: A booking form component that collects service type, category, customer name, phone, and preferred date, submits to a backend via a custom hook, and generates a WhatsApp deep-link to notify the admin with booking details.
frontend/src/components/home/AboutSectio: A static 'About Us' section displaying a two-column layout with descriptive text about Omm Vedic Numerology and a grid of four feature cards highlighting key qualities.
frontend/src/components/home/FindUsSecti: A static section displaying the business's physical address in Bhubaneswar with a Google Maps deep-link button and decorative cosmic styling.
frontend/src/components/home/HeroSection: The full-screen hero section with a background image, animated stars, the brand name, tagline, pricing note, and two CTA buttons for booking and exploring services.
frontend/src/components/home/ServiceCard: A card component that displays a single service's icon, name, descriptions, price, and a 'Book Now' button that triggers a callback with the service ID.
frontend/src/components/home/ServicesSec: A section that renders a responsive grid of ServiceCard components for all available services, with a header and a pricing note footer.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: A fixed navigation header with a logo, desktop nav links that scroll to page sections, a subtle admin panel link, and a collapsible mobile menu.
frontend/src/data/services.ts: Defines the `ServiceData` interface and exports an array of four astrology/spiritual services (Tarot, Numerology, Vastu, Pronology) with metadata like price, icon, and descriptions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminQueries.ts: Provides two React Query hooks: `useIsCallerAdmin` to check if the current user is an admin, and `useGetAllBookings` to fetch all bookings when the caller is confirmed as admin.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using `@dfinity/auth-client`, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Exports a `useCreateBooking` mutation hook that calls the backend actor's `createBooking` method and invalidates the bookings query cache on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports Google Fonts, sets up Tailwind layers, defines a cosmic dark theme with OKLCH CSS variables, and adds custom utility classes for gold gradients, glows, and typography.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` into the root DOM element.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Admin dashboard page that handles Internet Identity login/logout, displays all bookings in a table for authenticated admins, and includes a WhatsApp alert link for pending bookings.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main public-facing page that composes the Hero, Services, About, FindUs, and Booking sections with smooth-scroll navigation, a booking form with optional service preselection, and a footer with social links.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining a custom theme with cosmic/gold color palette, custom fonts (Cinzel, Cormorant Garamond, Inter), animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for 'Omm Vedic Numerology' website, documenting existing features, known issues, architectural notes, and versioning for a spiritual services booking site with an in-progress admin panel.
